# PCE Nigeria Limited (pcenigeria.com)

> PCE Nigeria Limited is a premier engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) company specializing in Horizontal Directional Drilling (HDD), major oil & gas pipeline crossings (AKK & OB3 projects), specialized Lantic Bentonite, high-performance drilling fluid additives, and 3D Buried Pipeline Detection Systems (BPDS).

## Core Capabilities & Services
- [Horizontal Directional Drilling (HDD)](https://www.pcenigeria.com/capabilities#hdd): Specialist trenchless engineering for river, road, and coastal crossings using 1200t and 500t heavy drilling rigs.
- [52km Pipeline EPC Construction](https://www.pcenigeria.com/capabilities#epc): Full EPC delivery including trenching, pipe bending, automatic welding, NDT, hydrotesting, and commissioning.
- [BPDS Buried Pipeline Detection System](https://www.pcenigeria.com/capabilities#bpds): Non-destructive 3D electromagnetic mapping of deeply buried steel pipelines beneath rivers and complex terrain.
- [Equipment & Technical Fleet](https://www.pcenigeria.com/equipment-technology): High-pressure mud pumps, mud recycling solids control systems, and continuous electronic tracking guidance tools.

## High-Performance Drilling Fluids & Lantic Bentonite Products
- [BRSBENT SQ (Lantic Bentonite)](https://www.pcenigeria.com/products/brsbent-sq): API 13A high-yield activated sodium bentonite for HDD, slurry TBMs, and deep foundation drilling fluids.
- [BRSCMC (Carboxymethyl Cellulose)](https://www.pcenigeria.com/products/brscmc): High-purity fluid loss control polymer and rheology modifier for water-based drilling muds.
- [BRSMMH (Mixed Metal Hydroxide)](https://www.pcenigeria.com/products/brsmmh): Inorganic viscosifier producing high yield point, shear-thinning muds for gravel and sand stabilization.
- [BRSVR (Clay Viscosity Reducer)](https://www.pcenigeria.com/products/brsvr): Specialty clay stripper and dispersing agent designed to thin reactive clay slurries and prevent bit balling.
- [BRSXTG (Xanthan Gum Biopolymer)](https://www.pcenigeria.com/products/brsxtg): High-molecular-weight biopolymer providing exceptional shear-thinning viscosity and hole cleaning.

## Key Infrastructure Projects
- [AKK River Niger HDD Crossing Project](https://www.pcenigeria.com/projects/akk-river-niger): Landmark 48-inch gas pipeline crossing beneath the River Niger for the Ajaokuta-Kaduna-Kano (AKK) pipeline network.
- [OB3 River Niger HDD Crossing Project](https://www.pcenigeria.com/projects/ob3-river-niger): Complex 48-inch pipeline river crossing for the Obiafu-Obrikom-Oben (OB3) gas project.
- [52km Pipeline EPC Project](https://www.pcenigeria.com/projects/52km-pipeline-epc): Turnkey EPC pipeline construction in challenging swamp and riverine terrain.
- [Raoyang River HDD Crossing](https://www.pcenigeria.com/projects/raoyang-river-hdd): Record-setting 2,293-meter continuous HDD crossing.

## Key Keyword Index
- **HDD**: Horizontal Directional Drilling, trenchless crossing, rig pulling force.
- **AKK**: Ajaokuta-Kaduna-Kano Gas Pipeline Project, River Niger Crossing.
- **OB3**: Obiafu-Obrikom-Oben Gas Pipeline Project, Gas Interconnect.
- **pcenigeria**: PCE Nigeria Limited, www.pcenigeria.com.
- **Lantic**: Lantic Bentonite, Lantic Industrial Mineral Products.
- **Bentonite**: Activated Sodium Bentonite, Montmorillonite Clay, API 13A.
- **Drilling Fluid**: Drilling mud, viscosifiers, fluid loss additives, mud recycling.
- **BPDS**: Buried Pipeline Detection System, 3D electromagnetic mapping.
